provenance.creator: Independent research / not Xiaomi

sourceEvidence.officialStyleNames: MiMo Studio 2026-07-23 changelog: Rational Humanistic, Dark Tech

notes: The two style names are taken from a specific official MiMo Studio release. Their use as global personal-study modes is an original abstraction.
Research, Developer, Workspace are scene contexts inferred from official pages, not three official MiMo themes.
Every numeric token is a candidate for personal reuse, NOT extracted official CSS.

identity.name: MiMo-inspired / Rational-Technical Humanism
identity.vision: Make intelligence feel capable, comprehensible and close to people.
stablePrinciples: Indexes, rules and clear directional affordances
Tools appear as content, not as decorative metaphor
identity.aiGuidance: Use the case studies as inspiration rather than templates. Invent compositions when they better express the actual content; preserve the design's rational clarity and human warmth.

axes.combination: any mode can be used in any context; 2 modes × 3 contexts = 6 scenarios

familiesCandidate.display: Inter, Arial, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif
familiesCandidate.body: Inter, Arial, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif

rational-humanistic.description: Luminous near-white paper, precise typography, warm neutral hierarchy, extremely restrained accent.

dark-tech.description: Deep neutral ink surfaces with crisp type and calm technical focus, not a neon cyberpunk treatment.

research.composition: Oversized display as anchor; serial indexes; alternating reading widths; high-quality content evidence
research.antiPattern: Repeat a three-card marketing grid on every page

developer.composition: Command strip as primary action; transparent setup steps; readable terminal and code examples
developer.antiPattern: Decorative pseudo-code that cannot be read or copied

workspace.composition: Low-chrome shell with dominant task input, secondary navigation, clear result and task status
workspace.antiPattern: Oversized marketing headers obstruct repeated everyday operations

resourcePolicy.designLanguageVsAppAdapter: personal library independently defined; application integrations translate semantics, not duplicate styles

motionLanguage.identity: Explain state, direction, cause or a transformation that matters to understanding.
motionLanguage.reducedMotion: decorative motion disabled; functional changes remain understandable

qualityQuestions: Can viewers recognize the shared family without a logo?
Does changing presentationMode preserve content and semantics?
Do all scenarios remain legible, task-focused and keyboard-accessible?
Are any signature assets dependent on nonlicensed third-party material?
